MIDDLE.note: Safe blind pick with strong pick potential and side-lane pressure.

counters.reason: Wind Wall blocks Charm and denies your main pick tool.
Outscales you and shrugs off magic damage after level 11.
Can dodge Charm with Playful / Trickster and burst you.

synergies.reason: Reliable lockdown lets you land Charm for free.
Cataclysm traps targets inside your full combo.
Ranged engage creates easy charm angles.

tips: Push the first two waves, then hover the river for a level 4 roam.
Keep one charm charge for the enemy jungler instead of using it on cooldown.

MIDDLE.note: Top-tier lane bully with execute pressure and strong zone control.

counters.reason: Dodges your spheres and closes the gap instantly.
Shadow pressure forces you to hold E or die.
Wind Wall eats your stun and counters your poke.

synergies.reason: Lockdown guarantees a full sphere combo.
Point-and-click engage sets up your burst.

tips: Hold a sphere near the wave before trading so E always has a target.
Reset your mana with two points in Q before forcing an all-in.

MIDDLE.note: High-ceiling skirmisher. Strong with knock-up engage but punishable when behind.

counters.reason: Armor stacking and unavoidable knock-up pressure.
Point-and-click stun and early lane dominance.
Guaranteed stun bursts you before you can wind-wall.

synergies.reason: Unstoppable R sets up Last Breath.
AoE pull gives you free ultimate setup.
Body Slam and Explosive Cask create knock-ups.

tips: Track your E stacks before dashing into a trade; escape path matters more than damage.
Wind Wall is for the enemy's key spell, not for poke.

MIDDLE.note: Strong sidelane duelist with reliable engage and mixed damage.

counters.reason: Armor and hard engage deny your extended trades.
Early lane bully who punishes your weak first levels.
Stun and early burst keep you off the wave.

synergies.reason: Knock-up into Fate Sealed is almost guaranteed.
Double AoE engage collapses teamfights.

tips: Use E to bait cooldowns, then re-engage with the snap-back threat still available.
Do not blind-pick into heavy armor without a mixed-damage threat beside you.

MIDDLE.note: Elite flanker, but needs a lead and clean shroud usage.

counters.reason: Magic shield and taunt punish your dive pattern.
Anti-dash kit keeps you out of range.
Point-and-click stun and early pressure.

synergies.reason: Flag and drag creates a free dive target.
Lockdown lets you land the full combo.

tips: Hold shroud until the enemy commits their key spell.
Play for side-lane picks once your first item is complete.

MIDDLE.note: Long-range burst mage with excellent pick potential but low mobility.

counters.reason: Wind Wall denies binding and most of your damage.
Shunpo dodges skillshots and snowballs off your mistakes.
Assassin pressure forces you to stay under tower.

synergies.reason: Root sets up traps and long-range poke.
Binding guarantees Curtain Call damage.

tips: Use E on the wave to push safely, but keep Q for the all-in.
Stand outside assassin jump range until they show on the map.

UTILITY.note: Poke support with strong lane pressure; vulnerable to hard engage.

counters.reason: Hard engage closes the range gap instantly.
One hook ends the lane.
Point-and-click lockdown ignores your range advantage.

synergies.reason: Double long-range poke and trap setup.
Root into Curtain Call is deadly.

tips: Push for level 2 and crash the wave before the enemy engage support can all-in.
Buy a control ward before your first roam.

MIDDLE.note: Scaling pick that punishes low-mobility drafts; needs safe early waves.

counters.reason: Mobile assassin kills you before cage matters.
Roams and dives over walls to punish your immobility.
Dodges cage and bursts through your health bar.

synergies.reason: AoE lockdown guarantees cage and W.
Ranged engage stacks your passive and traps targets.

tips: Stack Q on the wave, not on the enemy champion, until Lost Chapter.
Place the cage slightly behind the target so they walk into the stun.

MIDDLE.note: Snowball assassin with strong roams, but easily disrupted in lane.

counters.reason: Taunt and magic shield stop your channel.
Anti-dash fear zones you out.
Stun interrupts Death Lotus and wins early trades.

synergies.reason: Knock-up sets up a clean ultimate channel.
AoE stun creates reset angles.

tips: Do not channel R until the enemy's interrupt is used.
Roam on dagger resets rather than forcing a losing lane.

MIDDLE.note: Flexible skirmisher whose value scales with the enemy ultimate.

counters.reason: Anti-dash zone denies your engage.
Outscales and matches your mobility.
Wall and zone control stop your chains.

synergies.reason: Strong engage ultimate to steal and follow up.
Unstoppable engage gives you a free dive.

tips: Look at the enemy draft before locking; the ultimate pool matters.
Hold E until the target commits a dash or flash.

TOP.note: Lane bully who snowballs hard but is kited by ranged tops.

counters.reason: Ranged kiting and blind deny your axe trades.
Condemn and mobility keep you out of hook range.
Scales past you and kites with ranged waves.

synergies.reason: Speed and revive let you reach the backline.
Speed aura and sustain cover your immobility.

tips: Crash the third wave and cheater recall for a long sword advantage.
Save E for the enemy's escape, not for the first trade.

TOP.note: Simple, durable sidelaner who punishes melee matchups.

counters.reason: Ranged poke and blind make every trade one-sided.
Kiting and true damage ignore your durability.
Blind and mushrooms deny your spin trades.

synergies.reason: Movement speed lets you reach carries.
Speed and revive compensate for your low range.

tips: Use Q to break slows before spinning away.
Play for the sidelane once your wave clear comes online.

TOP.note: Premier anti-AD engage tank with one of the best teamfight ults.

counters.reason: True damage and kiting ignore your armor stacking.
Max-health true damage shreds a tank build.
Magic damage and mobility bypass your strengths.

synergies.reason: Unstoppable R enables Last Breath.
Knock-up combos into Fate Sealed.
Ball on Malphite creates a guaranteed Shockwave.

tips: Hold R for the carry, not the first person you see.
Build armor early only when the enemy has two auto-attack threats.

TOP.note: Scaling diver with excellent pick and sidelane pressure.

counters.reason: Counter Strike blocks your Q and wins extended trades.
Parry punishes your hookshot engage.
Early lane pressure and bleed punish your weak levels.

synergies.reason: Ball delivery and follow-up damage on your dive.
Hero's Entrance turns your pick into a teamfight.

tips: Use the second Q for the true-damage trade, not the first one.
Hookshot walls to escape more often than to engage.

TOP.note: Duelist who wins sidelanes but struggles to engage teamfights.

counters.reason: Armor and attack speed slow blunt your vitals.
Steadfast Presence stops your dashes.
Ranged scaling and invulnerability deny your all-in.

synergies.reason: Stand United lets you splitpush with backup.
Global ultimate covers your side-lane pressure.

tips: Take short trades around vitals, then disengage before minions turn.
Parry the spell that starts the enemy combo, not the first auto.

TOP.note: Durable duelist who isolates key targets but is kited in open fights.

counters.reason: Kiting and true damage make your ultimate a trap.
Ranged pressure keeps you off the wave.
Grounding and sustained damage deny your engage.

synergies.reason: AoE lockdown lets you walk into range.
Engage sets up your isolation pick.

tips: Ult the champion whose damage you can actually survive.
Use W after the enemy commits burst, not before.

TOP.note: Teamfight drain tank with strong lane pressure and dive follow-up.

counters.reason: Parry and vitals punish your Q timings.
Mobility and true damage win the sidelane.
Dashes dodge your sweet spots.

synergies.reason: Chain CC keeps enemies inside your Q.
Arena traps targets for your combo.

tips: Hold E to reposition the third Q, not to start the combo.
Take short trades until your ult makes extended fights favorable.

JUNGLE.note: Early-game tempo jungler with elite pick tools and a high skill floor.

counters.reason: Sustain and fear make early invades risky.
Steadfast Presence blocks your Q dash.
Counter Strike wins the extended duel.

synergies.reason: Insec into Shockwave is a teamfight win condition.
Kick a target into her stun and burst.

tips: Path to the lane with the best setup, not the one that is losing hardest.
Ward-hop during clears to keep tempo and stay healthy.

JUNGLE.note: Point-and-click engage that reliably removes a carry.

counters.reason: Counter Strike blocks your engage and wins duels.
Anti-dash field stops your Q.
Sustain makes early skirmishes unfavourable.

synergies.reason: Lockdown guarantees Charm.
Free sphere combo on your ultimate.
Ball follow-up on the locked target.

tips: Do not open with R if the enemy still has a spell shield or cleanse.
Charge Q behind vision before ganking.

JUNGLE.note: Reset-based skirmisher who snowballs fights but needs clean target selection.

counters.reason: Sustain and suppression punish your early duels.
Anti-dash field blocks your only engage.
Chain CC stops you before resets start.

synergies.reason: Knock-up starts your reset chain.
AoE setup lets you take over fights.

tips: Play for the first reset; do not start fights you cannot finish.
Use E through walls to gank without spending flash.

JUNGLE.note: Beginner-friendly sustain jungler with strong early ganks.

counters.reason: Counter Strike and scaling win the duel.
Anti-dash field denies your gap close.
Grievous wounds and skirmish pressure match your sustain.

synergies.reason: Follow-up on your suppression.
Double engage collapses fights.

tips: Use the blood trail to find low-health targets after a fight.
Hold E for the burst window instead of fear-engineering every gank.

JUNGLE.note: Engage tank with reliable CC and excellent melee carry synergy.

counters.reason: Ranged invades and ult deny your engage windows.
True damage and kiting beat your tank stats.
Subjugate steals your resistances.

synergies.reason: Knock-ups enable Last Breath.
Chain engage into Fate Sealed.
CC sets up her ultimate.

tips: Stack your passive on the wave before engaging.
Use Q to break terrain only when the fight is already won.

JUNGLE.note: Pick-focused diver with map-wide pressure after level 6.

counters.reason: Anti-dash field blocks your engage.
Counter Strike wins the extended duel.
Sustain makes early skirmishes hard.

synergies.reason: Ball delivery on your ultimate.
Global follow-up turns your dive into a teamfight.

tips: Track vision before R; a blind dive into three people loses the game.
Spell shield is for the CC spell, not the first damage.

BOTTOM.note: Premier reset hypercarry with elite range and objective damage.

counters.reason: Assassin dive deletes you before you can DPS.
Wall jumps and burst bypass your range.
Invisible one-shot from the fog.

synergies.reason: Lantern saves you from every dive.
Shields and polymorph keep you alive.
Peel and passive stun protect your DPS window.

tips: Do not use Fishbones in every trade; mana and attack speed matter.
Stay at max rocket range until the enemy engage is used.

BOTTOM.note: Hybrid carry with strong dive follow-up and flexible build paths.

counters.reason: Range advantage and traps punish your short range.
Early damage overwhelms your scaling curve.
Assassin burst before you finish your items.

synergies.reason: Lockdown procs your passive and stacks.
Engage creates a free dive window.
Attack speed and shields accelerate your DPS.

tips: Evolve Q first into squishy comps, E first when you need safety.
Do not ult into a fight unless a teammate can follow the dive.

BOTTOM.note: Lane dominator who converts range into tower pressure and picks.

counters.reason: All-in damage beats your poke if you misstep.
Wind Wall and all-in threat deny your traps.
Assassin pressure forces you off the wave.

synergies.reason: Root sets up traps and Headshot.
Binding and black shield cover your positioning.
Hook and lantern create lane control.

tips: Place traps in the enemy's escape path, not under their feet.
Use net for safety; saving it for damage usually loses the fight.

BOTTOM.note: Safe, scaling poke carry with a high skill ceiling.

counters.reason: Early all-in punishes your tear scaling.
Range and trap control deny your poke angles.
Point-and-click lockdown ignores your mobility.

synergies.reason: Shield and speed amplify your poke.
Peel and attack speed cover your mid game.
Passive stuns on your Q volley.

tips: Hold E for the enemy engage; it is your only defensive tool.
Q through minions when the wave blocks the enemy's skillshots.

BOTTOM.note: Long-range pick carry with strong follow-up and objective control.

counters.reason: Wind Wall blocks your root and fourth shot.
Early all-in overwhelms your reload windows.
Assassin dive punishes your immobility.

synergies.reason: Hook into root and Curtain Call.
Binding enables your W from range.
Bubble and speed keep your DPS window clean.

tips: Manage reload before a fight; four shots decide the trade.
Use W to root targets your ally is already hitting.

BOTTOM.note: Utility carry with global engage; needs peel into dive comps.

counters.reason: Assassin pressure removes you before R matters.
Roams convert your immobility into deaths.
Ragnarok ignores your slows and CC.

synergies.reason: Passive stuns on every auto and arrow follow-up.
Peel and speed keep you at max range.
Lantern and hook cover your lack of mobility.

tips: Use E to scout the enemy jungler before pushing.
Save arrow for picks or disengage; do not open every fight with it.

UTILITY.note: Playmaking support with unmatched pick and peel tools.

counters.reason: Black Shield blocks your hook and flay.
Poke and plants win the lane before your engage.
Sustained poke punishes your melee range.

synergies.reason: Lantern and hook create a safe hypercarry lane.
Hook into trap is a guaranteed kill.
Lockdown enables his long-range weapons.

tips: Throw the lantern first when your carry is diving; the hook can wait.
Roam with your jungler after the first crash.

UTILITY.note: Hard-engage support with the best all-in pattern in the bot lane.

counters.reason: Black Shield negates your entire engage.
Disengage and shields deny your all-in.
Counter-engage and cleanse pressure.

synergies.reason: CC chains stack her passive and ultimate.
Engage procs her passive for a free dive.
Damage follows your lockdown.

tips: Engage on the wave crash, not into a stacked enemy wave.
Hold Q for the flash escape instead of using it immediately.

UTILITY.note: Top-tier enchanter who turns hypercarries into unkillable threats.

counters.reason: Hook range threatens you before shields come online.
Invisible roam pressure and execute threat.
Point-and-click lockdown ignores your polymorph if he reaches you.

synergies.reason: Attack speed and shields amplify her reset DPS.
Peel and attack speed enable the hypercarry.
Invisibility flank with Lulu shields is lethal.

tips: Polymorph is for the engage, not for poke.
Shield before the damage lands; the shield also grants attack speed.

UTILITY.note: Trade-focused enchanter with strong lane sustain and disengage.

counters.reason: Hard engage closes the range gap and locks you down.
Hook ends the lane if you stand in front of the wave.
Roam pressure and execute threat.

synergies.reason: Ebb and Flow plus Lightslinger wins every short trade.
Speed and sustain cover his scaling curve.
Bubble into traps and Headshot.

tips: Bounce W between allies and enemies for maximum value.
Use E on your carry before they commit, not after the fight starts.

UTILITY.note: Mobile playmaker with strong engage and disengage; fragile if caught first.

counters.reason: Black Shield stops your knock-up engage.
Disengage denies your all-in pattern.
Anti-dash field blocks your W.

synergies.reason: Duo passive and shared engage windows.
Engage sets up her dive.
Knock-up into her all-in.

tips: Use E back to your carry after the engage; you are not a frontline.
Rakan R is best used to disengage, not only to start fights.

UTILITY.note: Pick threat that punishes every misposition; falls off against shields and cleanse.

counters.reason: Black Shield makes your hook useless.
Spell shield and speed deny your engage.
Ragnarok ignores your hook and knock-up.

synergies.reason: Hook into trap is a guaranteed kill.
Hook sets up root and Curtain Call.
Immediate damage follow-up on the hook.

tips: Walk forward to threaten the hook before throwing it.
Do not hook the tank into your carry.

A: Quest: Rite Of The Forge God
